Maya R.: FYI hit a reproducible ESM/CJS interop + auth drop when building SDK with vite+esbuild for edge.
Maya R.: gist (internal): https://github.com/redwood-internal/repro-edge-esbuild-auth
Leo T.: symptoms?
Maya R.: CJS bundle picked by edge -> requests return 401 and runtime shows `TypeError: client.generate is not a function`. ESM build works.
Nina: likely esbuild wrapping exports into `{ default: ... }`. Edge resolver uses require() semantics so callers expecting default fail.
Maya R.: minimal steps:
1) npm i
2) npm run build:cjs (vite lib formats:['cjs'])
3) deno task start:edge
4) curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" http://localhost/_gen -> 401 + TypeError
Leo T.: quick workarounds: force ESM output or add tiny interop shim at package root: `module.exports = exports.default || exports`. Ugly but fixes.
